name.baseName: Tongwei N type half-piece double-glass photovoltaic module

quantitativeReference.functionalUnitOrOther: 1 Wp of manufactured photovoltaic module, from cradle-to-grave, with activities needed for a study period for a RSL of 25 years.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse: Components/materials: tempered solar glass, aluminum-alloy frame, N-type monocrystalline Si cells, EVA & POE encapsulants, copper interconnects/busbars, PPE/PPO junction box, silicone sealants; packaging uses corrugated board and a plywood pallet. Manufacturing keywords: cutting & string welding → EL/appearance testing → stacking → lamination → framing & junction-box bonding/terminal welding → curing → IV/insulation testing → automatic packaging. Use & EoL: Suitable for commercial/industrial rooftops and ground-mounted PV plants; operating temperature −40 to +85 °C; manufacturing, use, and end-of-life all take place in China.
technology.technologicalApplicability: Tongwei N type half-piece double-glass photovoltaic module is suitable for industrial and commercial roof and ground power stations. The PV module has high power generation and low cost per hour. The maximum power can reach 630W and the module efficiency can reach 23.3%. In addition, the component has passed a number of quality certifications, and the product quality is reliable and guaranteed.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.useAdviceForDataSet: This data set includes modules A1-A5, B2, C1-C4, and D.
